question.question: Where do placed and removed pieces normally come from/go, what happens to removed items, and when do effects of simultaneous removals trigger?

expected.expected_answer: Place from supply or leftmost prompted tracked piece. Remove to supply or rightmost empty track space; otherwise permanently, items permanently. Remove all simultaneous pieces before triggering removal effects.

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle; piece supply and simultaneous removal
source_passages.quotation: Removed faction pieces normally return to supply; tracked pieces return to the **rightmost empty track space**. Placement normally takes pieces from supply, or leftmost on a track. Items removed from the game are removed permanently. Pieces are finite: no proxies. When an instruction cannot place/take/remove all prompted pieces, **you must do the maximum possible and cannot voluntarily do fewer**; this never waives costs or prerequisites, nor the Eyrie's obligation to complete Decree actions. For simultaneous removal, remove all pieces before triggering removal effects. (1.5, G.20, G.24.)

answer.ruling: Placement normally uses pieces from supply or the leftmost space on a track. Removed faction pieces normally return to supply; tracked pieces go to the rightmost empty track space. Items removed from the game are removed permanently.
